requirements: Access to Dharok the Wretched's boss encounter and any prerequisite quests, keys, instances, or killcount listed by the linked strategy source.
Use the boss-task Slayer helm or Slayer helmet bonuses when the assignment permits it.
Bring supplies and teleports appropriate to a separate boss trip rather than a normal multi-kill Slayer location.

methods.label: General strategy
methods.summary: Dharok melees, so the shared BiS magic setup (air spells, 50% wind weakness) is the recommended kill - no per-brother switch.
recommendedFor: Players selecting this boss from the Boss meta-task
steps: Dharok melees, so the shared BiS magic setup (air spells, 50% wind weakness) is the recommended kill - no per-brother switch.

methods.label: Barrows route
methods.summary: Reach Barrows, enter Dharok's north-east mound early, and spend prayer before the underground drain grows dangerous.
recommendedFor: Boss Slayer assignments that roll Dharok
requiredOrKeyItems: Air spell runes or powered staff
steps: Travel with Barrows teleport, Mort'ton, Morytania legs, or fairy rings.
Check Dharok early in the rotation because he is the most dangerous brother without prayer.
Use Protect from Melee and kill him with air magic or the best available powered staff.
Continue the route before Prayer drain forces extra potion doses.
notes: The Wiki lists Dharok first in safe and fast rotations because low-hitpoint Dharok can one-hit players.
Ghommal's hilt 2 or higher removes the Barrows Prayer drain.

methods.label: Protection prayer kill
methods.summary: Protect from Melee and use air magic to kill Dharok before his low-hitpoint damage scaling becomes dangerous.
steps: Turn on Protect from Melee before opening Dharok's sarcophagus.
Keep distance only if using room pathing; otherwise tank with prayer active.
Use air spells, powered staves, or Iban Blast at lower levels.
Keep prayer above zero until Dharok dies.
risks: Dharok's damage rises as his hitpoints fall.
Missing prayer can result in a lethal melee hit.
notes: Dharok should generally be killed before less dangerous melee brothers.
All brothers have a 50% air elemental weakness.

methods.label: Tunnel safespot
methods.summary: Safespot Dharok behind tunnel ladders, corridor corners, or sarcophagus pathing if prayer is low, but avoid risky kiting mistakes.
prayers: Protect from Melee when not fully safespotted
steps: Use ladder squares or corridor geometry to make Dharok path around obstacles.
Attack with magic while he is blocked.
Avoid sarcophagus kiting Dharok when mistakes could cause a one-hit.
Use Protect from Melee any time the safespot is not stable.
risks: Dharok is the least forgiving melee brother to kite.
Some tunnel corridor entries do not have a nearby usable safespot.
notes: The Wiki recommends not kiting Dharok unless the player is confident.
Binding spells can also hold melee brothers in place.
